items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Hildred Humphries and... I forget the big old banjo player's name

ctx.x: Hildred Humphries and... I forget the big old banjo player's name; I don't think he ever amounted to anything. Hildred was doing all right for a while, but he's in some kind of other business. He lives upstate there somewhere. Do you know Frank Humphries?
